name: app-header
title: App Header
description: The bar at the top of an app-like view on a phone: a way back at the start, the view's title in the middle, one or two actions at the end. It sticks to the top, clears the notch or status bar (`env(safe-area-inset-top)`), and shows its surface and border…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/app-header

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/app-header.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/app-header';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/app-header

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
